text: # COD Policy Cash on Delivery orders require payment at the time of delivery.
COD orders follow the same product-specific return eligibility rules as other orders.
COD status can affect refund processing timelines.
# COD Refund Timeline For eligible COD returns, the refund is initiated after the returned item passes the required return checks.
COD refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days after refund initiation.
The exact credit time can depend on the payment or banking process.
# Customer Support Policy Customer support should use the order information and applicable policy before providing a resolution.
Policy answers should be based only on retrieved knowledge-base information.
If the available policy information does not support an answer, the assistant should state that it cannot confirm the policy rather than inventing a rule.
# Damaged Product Policy A damaged product should be reported through customer support as soon as possible after delivery.
The order and product details may be checked before approving a return, replacement, or refund.
Eligibility depends on the product and applicable return conditions.
# Delivery SLA Standard delivery is generally expected within 3 to 7 days from order confirmation.
The delivery estimate can vary based on the destination, product, and logistics conditions.
If an order passes its stated delivery estimate, the customer can request support.
# Missing Product Policy If an item expected in an order is missing, the customer should report the issue through support.
The order contents and shipment information may be checked before a resolution is provided.
Resolution depends on the order and applicable support policy.
# Payment Policy Customers may use supported payment methods shown during checkout.
Payment status should be verified against the order before support actions are taken.
A successful payment does not by itself guarantee that an order is eligible for return or refund.
# Prepaid Payment Policy Prepaid orders can use supported card, UPI, or wallet payment methods.
For an eligible prepaid return, the refund is processed after the required return checks.
The refund destination depends on the original payment method and applicable processing rules.
# Replacement Policy Replacement is available only for eligible products and eligible issue types.
A replacement request must satisfy the applicable product and return conditions.
If replacement is unavailable, an eligible return or refund option may be considered.
# Return Window by Category Apparel, Footwear, and Beauty products may be returned within 7 days of delivery when the item is eligible for return.
Electronics products may be returned within 10 days of delivery when the item is eligible for return.
Home products may be returned within 7 days of delivery when the item is eligible for return.
The applicable return window is counted from the delivery date.
# Reverse Pickup Eligibility Reverse pickup is available for eligible return requests in serviceable locations.
The item must satisfy the applicable return conditions and must be within its permitted return window.
Pickup availability depends on the delivery address and logistics coverage.
# Wrong Product Policy If the delivered product is different from the ordered product, the customer should report the issue through support.
The order details and delivered product may be verified before approving a resolution.
Eligible cases may receive replacement, return, or refund according to the applicable policy.
